content.title: Police Pension Board
content.summary: The City of Arvada Police Pension Board oversees the management of the police retirement system and meets quarterly on the second Thursday of February, May, August, and November at 3:30 pm. The board consists of eight members serving four-year terms, and recruitment for vacancies will begin in December for those interested in joining.
content.body:
## Overview

The City of Arvada Police Pension Board is responsible for overseeing the general administration and management of the police retirement system.

## Meeting Information

- 3:30 pm
- 2nd Thursday of the second month of each quarter

### [Upcoming Meetings and Agendas](/calendar.aspx?CID=33)

   **[Police Pension Board Meeting](/Calendar.aspx?EID=3479)**

   **[Police Pension Board Meeting](/Calendar.aspx?EID=3482)**

[View All](/calendar.aspx?CID=33)

/Calendar.aspx

## Board Details

- 8 members
- 4 yr terms
- Volunteer appointment
- Must be registered to vote in Arvada

## Interested in Joining the Arvada Police Pension Board?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
